name: Research Memory
description: Hypotheses, observations, trials and findings over time. Research notebooks, inquiry histories and lab studies.
reference_use_case: Research notebooks, inquiry histories and lab studies.
integrity_rule: Preserve the difference between hypotheses and established findings.
antipattern: Do not silently promote a hypothesis or failed trial to an established result.
design_question: How are uncertainty, provenance and revisions recorded?
situational_schema: Questions, hypotheses, trials and findings evolve over time with uncertainty preserved.
